name: Nezuko Kamado
summary: After being exposed to sunlight during the Swordsmith Village incident, Nezuko adapted to the demons' greatest natural weakness and became immune to sunlight. This unique evolution made her the first known demon capable of surviving direct sunlight and caused Muzan Kibutsuji to seek her out in order to acquire this ability for himself.

stats.durability: Varies, Likely Town level, likely higher
stats.range: Standard Melee Range, Several Meters with Blood Burst

weaknesses: Standard Demon Weaknesses other than sunlight
notes: Nezuko adapted to sunlight after being briefly burned by it and became immune to direct sunlight. The VS Battles profile rates this version at likely Town level with Massively Hypersonic+ speed. Her sunlight immunity removes the standard demon weakness to sunlight and is the defining trait of this key.
